title: Volumes
items: What is a volume?
A logical disk that the system presents to attached hosts
A physical drive inside a control enclosure
A RAID array of external LUs
A group of MDisks with the same extent size
Volume 是系統呈現給已連接 Host 的邏輯磁碟。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch4
Which volume types can be created on systems with a single-site (standard) topology?
Basic, mirrored, or custom volumes
Only HyperSwap volumes
Only stretched volumes
Only image-mode volumes
所有系統都支援 Standard Topology (單站點)，可建立 Basic、Mirrored 與 Custom Volume。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch4
What happens when you delete a volume that has a snapshot assigned?
The volume enters the Deleting state, is renamed with a del_ prefix and timestamp, and is deleted after all snapshots are deleted or expire
The volume and all its snapshots are deleted immediately
The deletion is rejected until the snapshots are removed manually
The volume becomes a thin-clone of the snapshot
刪除有 Snapshot 的 Volume 會進入 Deleting 狀態，名稱加上 del_ 前綴與時間戳記，待相關 Snapshot 全部刪除或到期才真正刪除。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch4
Which actions can be performed on a volume in the Deleting state?
None
Expand only
Rename only
Map to a new host
官方說明 Deleting 狀態的 Volume 不能執行任何動作。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch4 Note
How does a striped volume copy allocate extents?
One extent from each MDisk in the pool in turn, in a round-robin similar to RAID-0
All extents from a single MDisk sequentially
Only from the MDisk with the most free capacity
Randomly across pools
Striped Volume Copy 以 Round-robin 方式輪流從 Pool 中每個 MDisk 取一個 Extent，類似 RAID-0 Striping。
Concept Guide Ch4 Types
Which command checks the available capacity on each MDisk before manually specifying a stripe set?
lsfreeextents
lsmdiskextent
lsvdiskextent
lsmdiskfree
不確定容量是否足夠時，可用 `lsfreeextents` 檢查每個 MDisk 的可用容量，或讓系統自動選擇 Stripe Set。
Concept Guide Ch4 Attention
What is true about an image-mode volume?
LBA x on the MDisk is the same as LBA x on the volume, and the MDisk is not virtualized
Its data is striped across all MDisks
It must be at least 1 TB
It cannot be migrated later
Image-mode Volume 與單一 MDisk 直接對應，MDisk 不被虛擬化，MDisk 的 LBA x 等於 Volume 的 LBA x。
Concept Guide Ch4 Image
What is the minimum size of an image-mode volume copy?
The extent size of the storage pool it is assigned to
1 GB
512 bytes
The size of the largest MDisk
Image-mode Volume Copy 至少要一個 Extent 大小，即所屬 Pool 的 Extent Size。
Concept Guide Ch4 Image
After one or more extents of an image-mode volume are moved to other MDisks, what changes?
The volume becomes virtualized and the MDisk mode changes from image to managed
The volume goes offline
The MDisk becomes unmanaged
The volume is converted to a snapshot
搬移 Extent 後 Volume Copy 成為虛擬化磁碟，MDisk 模式由 Image 變為 Managed。
Concept Guide Ch4 Image
If the pool containing an image-mode volume goes offline but its associated MDisk is online, what happens to the image-mode volume?
It remains online
It goes offline with the pool
It becomes degraded
It is deleted
Image-mode Volume 透過與 MDisk 的關聯受控，因此 MDisk Online 時即使 Pool Offline，該 Volume 仍維持 Online。
Concept Guide Ch4 Image
To maintain replication on an external storage system until a new recovery copy is established, how should an image-mode volume be created?
With cache mode none, then changed to readwrite later
With cache mode readonly permanently
As a thin-provisioned volume
As a compressed volume in a data reduction pool
先以 Cache Mode none 建立 Image-mode Volume，待新的 Recovery Copy 建立後再改為 readwrite。
Concept Guide Ch4 Image
If a volume deletion fails because it is still mapped to hosts, what can you do?
Specify the force-delete flag, which also deletes host mappings and Copy Services relationships
Shrink the volume to zero first
Move the volume to another pool
Set the volume to read-only
使用 force 刪除會一併刪除 Host Mapping 與 Copy Services Relationship。
Concept Guide Ch4
When is a volume in the Degraded state?
When one node in the I/O group is online and the other is missing or cannot access any synchronized copy
When both nodes in the I/O group are missing
When the volume is being deleted
When a thin volume runs out of space
I/O Group 中一個 Node Online、另一個遺失或無法存取任何同步 Copy 時，Volume 為 Degraded。
Concept Guide Ch4 Table 24
When does a thin-provisioned volume go offline?
When a user attempts to write more data than the available disk space
When its real capacity reaches 50%
When Easy Tier moves its extents
When a snapshot is taken
Thin-provisioned Volume 在寫入量超過可用空間時會 Offline。
Concept Guide Ch4 Table 24
What is the default cache mode for volumes?
readwrite
readonly
none
writethrough
readwrite 是所有 Volume 的預設 Cache Mode；Data Reduction Pool 的 Volume 必須是 readwrite。
Concept Guide Ch4 Table 25
What happens if you try to create a thin-provisioned volume copy in a data reduction pool with a cache mode other than readwrite?
The operation fails
The volume is created as fully allocated
The cache mode is ignored
The volume is created in a standard pool instead
Data Reduction Pool 中的 Thin 或壓縮 Volume Copy 必須使用 readwrite，否則建立失敗。
Concept Guide Ch4 Table 25
How many physical copies does a basic volume have?
One
Two
Three
Zero; it is virtual only
Basic Volume 只有一個實體 Copy，位於單一 Pool，支援任何 Topology 與 Striped、Sequential、Image 虛擬化類型。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch4 Basic volumes
In the management GUI, how is the primary copy of a mirrored volume indicated?
With an asterisk (*)
With a lock icon
With bold text
With the word PRIMARY in the name
GUI 以星號 (*) 標示 Mirrored Volume 的主要 Copy，它是優先供讀取的 Copy。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch4 Mirrored volumes
When a server writes to a mirrored volume, what does the system do?
Writes the data to both copies
Writes only to the primary copy
Writes to the copy with lower latency only
Writes to a journal and copies later
寫入 Mirrored Volume 時資料會同時寫到兩個 Copy；讀取則優先使用主要 Copy。
簡報 S4、S5；Concept Guide Ch4
Can servers access a volume while a newly added copy is synchronizing?
Yes
No, the volume is offline until synchronization completes
Only for reads
Only if the volume is image mode
新增 Copy 後系統會同步新 Copy，同步期間 Host 仍可存取 Volume。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch4
Which command adds a copy to an existing basic volume?
addvdiskcopy
mkvdiskcopy
splitvdiskcopy
chvdisk -addcopy
`addvdiskcopy` 將 Basic Volume 轉成 Mirrored Volume；GUI 為 Add Volume Copies。
Concept Guide Ch4 Adding a copy to a basic volume
Why should multiple quorum candidate disks be configured on different storage systems when using volume mirroring?
Volume mirroring keeps state data on quorum disks, and mirrored volumes can go offline if no quorum disk is available
Quorum disks store the volume data
Quorum disks improve read performance
Volume mirroring requires one quorum per volume
Volume Mirroring 的同步狀態記錄在 Quorum Disk；無 Quorum 可用時 Mirrored Volume 可能被迫 Offline。
Concept Guide Ch4 Mirrored volumes
With write fast failover, what timeout does the system use for writes to each copy?
10 seconds
1 second
30 seconds
5 minutes
寫入同時送到兩個 Copy，逾時為 10 秒；一邊成功、另一邊超過 10 秒時，慢的請求逾時結束。
Concept Guide Ch4 Write fast failovers
After a write fast failover, for how long does volume mirroring stop using the slow copy?
4 - 6 minutes
10 - 20 seconds
1 hour
Until the administrator re-enables it
Volume Mirror 會停止使用慢的 Copy 約 4–6 分鐘，期間由同步的 Copy 服務 I/O，之後再嘗試同步。
Concept Guide Ch4 Write fast failovers
What is the default value of mirror_write_priority when a volume is created with mkvdisk?
latency
redundancy
balanced
throughput
預設為 latency，啟用 Fast Failover；設為 redundancy 會停用 Fast Failover，改執行完整 ERP，最長可達 5 分鐘。
Concept Guide Ch4 Write fast failovers
Is the read fast failover function configurable?
No, it is always enabled and does not make copies out of sync
Yes, with chvdisk -readfailover
Yes, only in HyperSwap topology
It is disabled by default
Read Fast Failover 一律啟用，主要讀取 Copy 變慢時改讀另一個 Copy 4–6 分鐘，且不會使 Copy 不同步。
Concept Guide Ch4 Read fast failovers
Before performing maintenance that might affect data integrity on one copy of a mirrored volume, what should you do?
Check that both copies are synchronized, then remove that volume copy
Set mirror_write_priority to redundancy
Disable read fast failover
Shrink the volume
Volume Mirroring 提升可用性但不保證資料正確；維護前應確認兩個 Copy 已同步，再移除受影響的 Copy。
Concept Guide Ch4 Maintaining data integrity
When mirrored volume copies are no longer identical, which GUI action is used?
Validate Volume Copies
Repair Volume Mirror
Resync Copies
Split Volume Copy
在 GUI 選取 Volume Copy，從 Actions 選 Validate Volume Copies，可只驗證，或驗證並標記與修復差異。
簡報 S6
When repairing differences without assuming either copy is correct, what does the host receive when reading a differing sector?
A medium error
The data from the primary copy
Zeros
The data from the most recently written copy
不假設任何一方正確時，發現差異的 Sector 會被標記，Host 讀取時收到 Medium Error。
簡報 S6
What is the relationship between real capacity and provisioned capacity for a standard-provisioned volume?
Real capacity equals provisioned capacity
Real capacity is always smaller
Real capacity is zero until data is written
Provisioned capacity is twice the real capacity
Standard-provisioned Volume 建立時即使用全部容量，Real Capacity 等於 Provisioned Capacity。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch4 Standard-provisioned volumes
Why can standard-provisioned volumes achieve higher I/O rates than thin-provisioned volumes on the same MDisks?
They do not need the extra metadata that describes thin-provisioned volume contents
They bypass the cache
They use a larger extent size
They are always striped across more MDisks
Standard-provisioned Volume 不需要 Thin Volume 的額外 Metadata，因此 I/O 速率可能較高。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch4
Which parameter affects how long a standard-provisioned volume takes to format?
The mirror synchronization rate (-syncrate)
The extent size only
The host type
The cache mode
格式化時間取決於 Volume 大小與 Mirror Synchronization Rate；`mkvdisk` 的 -syncrate 控制格式化與同步速度。
Concept Guide Ch4 Standard-provisioned volumes
When is skipping the format of a standard-provisioned volume useful?
When the volume will be the target of a Copy Services function
When the volume is in a data reduction pool
When the volume is mapped to many hosts
When the volume is image mode
若 Volume 將成為 Copy Services 的 Target，Copy Services 作業本身會格式化 Volume，可略過格式化。
Concept Guide Ch4 Standard-provisioned volumes
What is required for compressed volumes according to the deck?
They must reside in a data reduction pool
They must be fully allocated
They must use image mode
They must be mapped to NVMe hosts
簡報整理：Compressed Volume 寫入時壓縮、讀取時解壓，需位於 Data Reduction Pool。
簡報 S7
How does deduplication identify duplicate data?
By comparing signatures (hashes) and replacing duplicates with references, only among volumes marked as deduplicated
By comparing file names
By scanning all volumes on the system regardless of settings
By comparing LBAs only
Deduplication 以 Signature (Hash) 比對，重複資料以 Reference 取代，且只在標記為 Deduplicated 的 Volume 之間進行。
簡報 S7
What does volume protection prevent?
Accidental deletion of volumes or host mappings with recent I/O
Unauthorized host access
Data corruption on mirrored copies
Pool overprovisioning
Volume Protection 防止誤刪近期有 I/O 的 Volume 或 Host Mapping；為全域設定，新系統預設啟用。
簡報 S8
For volume protection on a pool to take effect, what is required?
It must be enabled at both the system level and the pool level
Only the pool level
Only the volume level
It must be enabled on every host
系統層與 Pool 層都啟用時，Pool 的 Volume Protection 才會生效。
簡報 S8
From where does shrinking a volume remove capacity?
From the end of the disk, whether or not it is in use
Only from unused areas
From the beginning of the disk
From the least frequently used extents
Shrink 會從磁碟尾端移除容量，不論是否使用中，因此有資料時不要 Shrink。
簡報 S9
Which command checks for dependent volumes before taking a node offline?
lsdependentvdisks
lsnodedependentvdisks
lsvdiskdependency
lsvdisknode
Node 離線或移除時，依賴它的 Volume 會離線；操作前先以 `lsdependentvdisks` 檢查。
簡報 S9
Which situation can make volumes dependent on a node?
The cache contains pinned data
The volume has a snapshot policy
The volume is thin-provisioned
The volume is in a child pool
常見原因：Flash Drive 持有唯一同步 Copy、Node 是唯一可存取 MDisk 者、Partner Node 離線、Cache 有 Pinned Data。
簡報 S9
What happens when I/O exceeds a volume throttle limit?
The system delays processing of the I/O
The I/O fails with an error
The volume goes offline
The excess I/O is redirected to another node
超過 Throttle 的 Bandwidth 或 IOPS 上限時，系統會延後處理 I/O。
簡報 S10
Why are volumes placed in a volume group?
To manage related volumes together and ensure consistency with snapshots or replication
To share a single host mapping
To enable compression
To reduce the extent size
Volume Group 將相關 Volume 一起管理，搭配 Snapshot 或 Replication 確保一致性，可用於 Safeguarded Copy、HA 與 DR。
簡報 S10
Which cloud storage provider types are supported for cloud snapshots?
OpenStack Swift, Microsoft Azure, Amazon S3, and Ceph Object Storage
Only IBM Cloud Object Storage
Only NFS and SMB shares
Google Drive and Dropbox
Cloud Snapshot 支援 OpenStack Swift、Microsoft Azure、Amazon S3 與 Ceph Object Storage。
簡報 S11
What must be configured before setting up cloud snapshots?
DNS servers (up to two)
An NTP server only
A syslog server
An LDAP server
Cloud Snapshot 需先設定 DNS Server (最多 2 個，IPv4 或 IPv6)，且連線必須使用 TLS。
簡報 S11
Which operation is NOT allowed on a cloud volume?
Expand or shrink
Mapping to a host
Reading data
Taking a cloud snapshot
Cloud Volume 不能 Expand 或 Shrink。
簡報 S12
What happens to the expiration of the most recent snapshot when a threat is detected?
It is extended to 7 days by default
It is deleted immediately
It is set to never expire
It is moved to the cloud
偵測到 Threat 時，最新 Snapshot 的到期時間預設延長為 7 天。
簡報 S13
What is the difference between a thin-clone and a clone of a snapshot?
A thin-clone stays space efficient and always depends on the snapshot; a clone becomes an independent volume
A thin-clone is independent; a clone depends on the snapshot
Both are always independent
Both always depend on the snapshot
Thin-clone 維持空間效率且永遠相依於 Snapshot；Clone 會成為獨立 Volume。
簡報 S13
What is the difference between snapshot Restore and Refresh?
Restore overwrites the production volume group; Refresh updates a thin-clone from the snapshot
Restore updates a thin-clone; Refresh overwrites production
Both create new volumes
Both delete the snapshot
Restore 以 Snapshot 覆寫正式 Volume Group (Restore in Place)；Refresh 以 Snapshot 更新 Thin-clone 資料。
簡報 S14、S15
Who can delete a Safeguarded snapshot before its expiration?
Only a Security Administrator
Any Administrator
The volume owner
No one, including IBM Support
Safeguarded Snapshot 有到期時間與提早刪除限制，僅 Security Administrator 可提早刪除。
簡報 S15
To recover corrupted thin-provisioned or compressed volumes in a standard pool after a T3 recovery, which command is used?
repairsevdiskcopy
recovervdiskbysystem only under IBM supervision
rmvdisk -force
repairvdiskcopy
Standard Pool 中損壞的 Thin 或壓縮 Volume 使用 `repairsevdiskcopy`；Data Reduction Pool 內損壞的 Volume 須在 IBM Support 監督下執行 recovervdiskbysystem。
簡報 S16
